caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded bottle-like object centered within a rectangular frame. The object has a bulbous lower body, a narrower neck, and a short, slightly curved spout or top. The surface of the object shows careful shading to suggest curvature and dimensionality, with gradients from light to dark gray tones created by pencil or graphite. There are two distinct horizontal bands or ridges—one around the widest part of the lower body and another near the base of the neck. The object is set against a plain, unshaded background, and the paper itself is a light beige or off-white color. The artist’s signature, "Charles Cullen," is written in cursive below the bottom right of the rectangle containing the drawing.
title: Nursing Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
